observation_format.note: Inferred: CLI process stdout/logs are the observations.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: install local coding CLIs and run tasks through local processes
tool_call_format.note: Orchestrator invokes provider CLIs as processes; inner tool-call format is the delegated CLI's own.

protocol_standardization.note: OpenClaw gateway bridge; no MCP evidence in available material.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Orchestrator asks whether to hold a team-leader meeting first.
loop_primitives.note: Directive -> planning/meeting -> delegation; WebSocket live status updates.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Full task lifecycle — Inbox, Planned, Collaborating, In Progress, Review, Done — with drag-and-drop

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Server stores it as `directive`, broadcasts company-wide, then delegates to Planning (and mentioned departments when included).
multi_agent_topology.note: CEO -> planning lead -> department agents; departments/leaders.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: | POST | `/api/agents/:id/spawn` | Spawn assigned task execution directly from an agent card |

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: 프로젝트 활성 항목이 모두 `review` 상태일 때 바로 팀장 회의를 시작하지 않고 Decision Inbox 승인 대기
human_in_loop.note: Decision inbox approval gates; git worktrees 'merged only on CEO approval'; yolo-mode module suggests configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Local-first architecture — All data stored locally in SQLite
short_term_state.note: Tasks, subtasks, agent states persisted as typed records.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: 600+ categorized skills (Frontend, Backend, Design, AI, DevOps, Security, etc.) with custom skill upload support
long_term_memory.note: Skills learn/unlearn persisted; AGENTS.md orchestration rules file.

state_persistence.note: Also stale 'working' agents recover automatically after interrupted runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: AI-generated meeting summaries with multi-round review approval
self_verification.note: QA/QC department and review stage are agent-based review, not harness-run tests.

retry_policy.note: Supplement rounds reopen tasks after review rejection; no fixed cap documented.

rollback.evidence_quote: | POST | `/api/tasks/:id/discard` | Discard task worktree and abandon branch changes |

termination_condition.evidence_quote: lifecycle startup and interval sweeps now reset agents that are still marked `working` without a live `in_progress` task
termination_condition.note: Task completion reports end runs; timeout/stall sweeps recover stuck tasks.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: API model assignment now starts from the development pack and expands to initialized office packs
cost_controls.note: Per-agent provider/model assignment across CLI/OAuth/API providers.

timeouts.note: Per-operation timeouts (meeting one-shot, update git commands); no per-run cap documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: install local coding CLIs and run tasks through local processes
execution_isolation.note: Docker compose deployment is a documented alternative.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: New project creation path in direct-chat escalation is restricted by `PROJECT_PATH_ALLOWED_ROOTS`.
filesystem_access.note: Also git worktree isolation per agent.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Development server binds to `127.0.0.1`, not exposed to network
network_policy.note: Only server bind address is restricted; no egress restriction on agent actions documented.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Each agent works in isolated git branches, merged only on CEO approval
permission_model.note: Approval is at merge/decision points, not per tool call; closest available value.

tracing.evidence_quote: `test:comm:suite` writes machine-readable evidence to `logs/` and a markdown report to `docs/`.
tracing.note: Task logs, terminal logs, security audit log; no OpenTelemetry evidence.

replayability.note: Logs are viewable but no replay endpoint or module found in file tree.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Built-in `test:comm:*` scripts for CLI/OAuth/API communication validation with retry and evidence logs
eval_hooks.note: Only connectivity/QA self-tests; no benchmark evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The command parser rejects shell metacharacters (`;`, `|`, `&`, `` ` ``, `$`, `<`, `>`) and blocks direct shell launchers
guardrails.note: Also 'Queue sanitized interrupt prompt' and PROJECT_PATH_ALLOWED_ROOTS.

open_source.evidence_quote: [Apache 2.0](LICENSE) — Free for personal and commercial use.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Connect agents to external LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Together, Groq, Cerebras, custom)

first_release_date.note: Release notes list v1.0.1 as earliest doc but no date given.
